title: One Chance for Yao Lao
summary: Jia Xing Tian and Hai Bodong end their fight above the capital as sparring, and Jia Xing Tian welcomes his old friend back as a match for the Misty Cloud Sect. Jia Xing Tian tests Yan Xiao with a light blow and asks who his master is, but Xiao Yan says his master lives hidden in the mountains. Hai Bodong reckons Jia Xing Tian is an Eight-Star or Nine-Star Dou Huang close to Dou Zong, and warns that he watches the Mite'er family, the Nalan Clan and the Mu Clan and will try to recruit Xiao Yan. In his room, Xiao Yan refines the Seven Magical Green Spirit Saliva with the Heavenly Flame and feeds it to Yao Lao; it sets off one surge of his master's Soul Power but does not wake him. Meanwhile Chu Yun Empire agents ready a plot against the Jia Ma Empire's alchemists. On the road to the capital, Xiao Zhan saves a Mite'er family man from Chu Yun Empire killers and asks him to take him to Ya Fei.
events: Jia Xing Tian and Hai Bodong call off their bout and greet each other as old friends.
Jia Xing Tian tests Yan Xiao and asks about his master.
Hai Bodong rates Jia Xing Tian an Eight- or Nine-Star Dou Huang near Dou Zong.
Xiao Yan refines the Seven Magical Green Spirit Saliva while Hai Bodong stands guard.
Yao Lao's Soul Power surges once, but he does not wake.
Chu Yun Empire men prepare their plan before dawn.
Xiao Zhan rescues a Mite'er family man attacked by Chu Yun Empire killers.
The two head for Ya Fei so Xiao Zhan can look for Xiao Yan.
cultivation: Hai Bodong says Jia Xing Tian is either an Eight-Star or a Nine-Star Dou Huang and could break through to Dou Zong. The Seven Magical Green Spirit Saliva fails to wake Yao Lao.
